output.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), 0) AS rev_2024,
         COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'), 0) AS rev_2025
  FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
  WHERE o.is_revenue
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM yearly
WHERE rev_2024 > 0
  AND rev_2025 < 0.5 * rev_2024
output.explanation: Counts customers with positive net revenue in calendar year 2024 whose 2025 net revenue was less than half of their 2024 amount. Only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue) are included, and revenue means net_revenue. Customers with no revenue in 2025 are counted, since zero is less than half.
